---
name: Feature request
about: Describe a missing capability and the problem it would solve
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
---

## What would you like to do?

Describe the user-visible behavior and a concrete example. Explain what the
current system prevents or makes difficult.

## How should authority work?

Identify the resources involved and who should be allowed to use them. If the
proposal changes the capability model, explain how it preserves explicit grants
and avoids implicit inheritance.

## What alternatives have you considered?

Describe existing features or smaller changes that could address the problem.
Mark any implementation sketch as a proposal rather than an existing interface.
